title: WHO COUNTED
note: On-screen numbers are from NOAA Fisheries pages; illustrations are editorial.

lines.text: This rockfish was caught in the Aleutians in twenty twenty-two.
lines.t: This rockfish was caught in the Aleutians in twenty twenty-two.

lines.text: Its ear stones say it was born in eighteen seventy-eight.
lines.t: Its ear stones say it was born in eighteen seventy-eight.

lines.text: So who counted?
lines.t: So who counted?

lines.text: Every fish carries a pair of tiny ear stones, called otoliths.
lines.t: Every fish carries a pair of tiny ear stones, called otoliths.

lines.text: They grow a ring every year, like a tree.
lines.t: They grow a ring every year, like a tree.

lines.text: NOAA scientists count the rings under microscopes, more than thirty thousand a year.
lines.t: NOAA scientists count the rings under microscopes, more than thirty thousand a year.

lines.text: Now there's a faster reader.
lines.t: Now there's a faster reader.

lines.text: Near-infrared light hits the stone, and machine learning turns its signature into an age.
lines.t: Near-infrared light hits the stone, and machine learning turns its signature into an age.

lines.text: Per NOAA, that's six hundred to eight hundred percent more efficient.
lines.t: Per NOAA, that's six hundred to eight hundred percent more efficient.

lines.text: But to tie a signature to an age, you need the age first.
lines.t: But to tie a signature to an age, you need the age first.

lines.text: In twenty twenty-three, NOAA trained and tested its models on eight thousand six hundred seventeen pollock stones.
lines.t: In twenty twenty-three, NOAA trained and tested its models on eight thousand six hundred seventeen pollock stones.

lines.text: They came from NOAA's archive, built ring by ring.
lines.t: They came from NOAA's archive, built ring by ring.

lines.text: Two and a half million otolith pairs, back to the nineteen sixties.
lines.t: Two and a half million otolith pairs, back to the nineteen sixties.

lines.text: Around two million once sat in an old airplane hangar in Seattle.
lines.t: Around two million once sat in an old airplane hangar in Seattle.

lines.text: Now, the fair case against.
lines.t: Now, the fair case against.

lines.text: A faster age only helps if it changes what fishery managers use.
lines.t: A faster age only helps if it changes what fishery managers use.

lines.text: NOAA called getting these ages into stock assessments the next step.
lines.t: NOAA called getting these ages into stock assessments the next step.

lines.text: Catch limits are set by managers, not machines, and the microscope stays in the process.
lines.t: Catch limits are set by managers, not machines, and the microscope stays in the process.

lines.text: So the win today is speed and method. That's real.
lines.t: So the win today is speed and method. That's real.

lines.text: But look where the speed came from.
lines.t: But look where the speed came from.

lines.text: Every age it gives back started as a ring somebody counted.
lines.t: Every age it gives back started as a ring somebody counted.
